import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

wt=Path("/Users/steventran/.do_again/selfdev-20261007")
expected="da7e46f5e07922eb63b7b48e71319588bd28d3d5"

def run(args):
    return subprocess.run(args,cwd=wt,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True).stdout

head=run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).strip()
status=run(["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).strip()
if head!=expected or status:
    raise SystemExit(f"unexpected state head={head} status={status!r}")

for rel in [
    "src/do_again/browser/runtime.py",
    "src/do_again/browser/__init__.py",
    "tests/test_browser.py",
    "tests/test_browser_hardening.py",
]:
    p=wt/rel
    print(f"=== {rel} ===")
    lines=p.read_text().splitlines()
    needles=[
        "_bootstrap_prompt","_rollover_project_chat","_build_rollover_checkpoint",
        "_rollover_needed","rollover_transaction","owned_chats",
        "archive_state","process_archive_queue","_record_owned_chat",
        "_chat_has_bootstrap_markers","DO_AGAIN_HANDOFF_READY",
        "DO_AGAIN_PROJECT_READY","checkpoint","unresolved","next_action"
    ]
    hits=[]
    for i,line in enumerate(lines,1):
        if any(n.lower() in line.lower() for n in needles):
            hits.append(i)
    seen=set()
    for i in hits[:90]:
        start=max(1,i-12); end=min(len(lines),i+45)
        if any(n in seen for n in range(start,end+1)):
            continue
        seen.update(range(start,end+1))
        print(f"--- {start}-{end} ---")
        for n in range(start,end+1):
            print(f"{n:04d}: {lines[n-1]}")
